result.question: Qual percentual de internacoes de cada ano entre 2019 e 2023 foi por capitulo CID?
result.gold_sql: WITH agg AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") AS ano, c."DS_CAPITULO" AS capitulo_cid, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN cid c ON i."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023 GROUP BY ano, c."DS_CAPITULO") SELECT ano, capitulo_cid, total_internacoes, ROUND(total_internacoes * 100.0 / SUM(total_internacoes) OVER (PARTITION BY ano), 2) AS percentual_no_ano FROM agg ORDER BY ano, percentual_no_ano DESC;
result.generated_sql: WITH total_internacoes AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023 ), internacoes_por_capitulo AS ( SELECT SUBSTR("DIAG_PRINC", 1, 1) AS cid_capitulo, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") AS ano, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023 GROUP BY cid_capitulo, ano ) SELECT ipc.cid_capitulo, ipc.ano, ROUND((ipc.total_internacoes * 100.0 / ti.total), 2) AS proporcao FROM internacoes_por_capitulo ipc CROSS JOIN total_internacoes ti ORDER BY ipc.cid_capitulo, ipc.ano;
